decisions.reason: Launched in 2024 close to the core range with its own page, the large bulk container is a low-cost option whose value is still uncertain, so it should stay on the market while demand reveals itself.
The valve complements the bulk-container line, costs little to keep listed, and has had too little time on the market to show it will fail, so the option stays open.

The take-back service fits the firm's move toward circular, service-based packaging and is cheap to maintain, but it is only mentioned rather than featured, so it carries somewhat more risk of being quietly dropped and still warrants keeping open while uncertainty resolves.
